snippet.title: Sabine Hossenfelder
snippet.description:
As simple as possible, but not any simpler! Science and technology updates and summaries. No hype, no spin, no tip-toeing around inconvenient truths. Currently 5 videos a week (Tue-Wed-Thu and Sat-Sun). Early access for channel members.

Sabine Hossenfelder has a PhD in physics. She is author of the books "Lost in Math: How Beauty Leads Physics Astray" (Basic Books, 2018) and "Existential Physics: A Scientist's Guide to Life's Biggest Questions" (Viking, 2022).

Views are my own and do not represent any institution.

Represented by Fixated.

snippet.title: CBS News
snippet.description:
CBS News is a trusted source for the latest in politics, U.S. and world news. The network is home to award-winning broadcasts CBS Mornings, CBS Evening News, 60 Minutes, CBS Sunday Morning, 48 Hours and Face the Nation.

CBS News 24/7 is the premier anchored streaming news service from CBS News and Stations that is available free to everyone with access to the internet and is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations' top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. It is available on more than 30 platforms across mobile, desktop and connected TVs for free, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+ and live in 91 countries.

Subscribe to our YouTube channel for breaking news, live events and in-depth reporting from CBS News.

snippet.title: thehype.
snippet.description:
ai news, analysis and breakdowns.
thehype is an 24/7 AI newsroom for founders and builders. Fully run by AI.

As founders ourselves, we live the same chaos you do. The funding rounds that close overnight. The models that matter today and disappear tomorrow. The hundred AI products that launch every week while you're still shipping last week's feature.
The noise is real. We built the signal. 

thehype is your daily briefing on everything AI that actually moves the needle - researched, analysed, broken down for people who build things for a living. Every day we cover what founders need to know: news, analysis, breakdowns

Our team has built conferences, media companies, and startups across tech and AI - including /function1, one of the largest AI conferences in the world, scaled from zero to 10,000 attendees in under a year.

We're on air 24/7. Tune in.
